about: The reference course the golden fixtures are played in. Its seed and warm-up firm are those of demo course P8 (firm P8-A), so the version 2 warm-up can be compared with a warm-up the version 1 engine actually stored. second_firm_id is P8-B, another firm in the same course, used only to show that from Quarter 4 every firm's market moves with the same draws.
